record.placement_rule: TRIAD.md: a joined part gets no literal transform. Every housing came out of connection:jst-eh-3pin's mate(); every cable's shape was derived by the router from the frames at its two ends.
record.bom_note: these are the pieces connection:jst-eh-3pin says a mated EH joint costs (housing + 3 crimps, and the board header EXCEPT where it is already inside a bought servo). They are not yet merged into bom.json, which another lane owns.
